description: Make a Wi-Fi QR code that phones join by scanning (WPA/WPA2/WPA3, WEP or open; hidden networks), as PNG or SVG, or a printable PDF card like the website's: coloured header with the Wi-Fi symbol, "Scan to join", the QR code, network name and (optionally) the password, on an A6 card, an A4 poster, or A4 sheets of 4 or 9 cards to cut. Special characters (; , : " \) are escaped. The PDF card uses English labels and Latin text only for now. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/wifi-card/

format.description: pdf = printable card sheet (default); png/svg = just the QR code.

layout.description: PDF: a6 = one A6 card; a4 = one A4 poster; a4x4 = A4 sheet of 4 cards (default); a4x9 = A4 sheet of 9 small cards.

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

security.description: WPA (WPA/WPA2/WPA3, default), WEP, or nopass (open network).

showPassword.description: PDF: print the password under the code.

theme.description: PDF: card colour; "saver" is an ink-saving outline.

name: qr_wifi
title: Wi-Fi QR code and card
